text:
Priya: Heads up — quick q on promo evidence window and payroll cutoffs for EMEA hires. Trying to finalize promos this cycle.
Aisha: Hi! cutoff for this promo cycle is 2026-04-20 23:59 UTC for manager approvals. evidence upload window is 2026-03-15 -> 2026-04-18.
Priya: thanks — and payroll effective date is the first of the month, right? if approved after cutoff how does backpay work?
Aisha: Payroll effective date is 2026-05-01 for this batch. If approvals come after cutoff we do retro pay back to 2026-05-01 start of pay period, processed in next payroll run. backpay timeline: 2 payroll cycles after approval typically.
Sam: quick clarification — international hires (EMEA/APAC) need local comp signoff. Who triggers that? :thinking_face:
Aisha: Managers upload evidence and mark region. People Ops routes to Local Comp for geo review automatically. If local comp flags an adjustment we notify manager with reason and comp-owner.
Diego: If a manager misses the evidence upload window, can we still submit an exception?
Aisha: Exceptions allowed but require People Ops + Manager Exec signoff. Submit exception using the form linked below with manager rationale + 2 supporting docs.
Aisha: Form (internal): https://redwood.company/internal/promo-exceptions (use Request Type = "Late Evidence")
Priya: Do we have an evidence template I can share with managers? Some are sending 1-paragraph notes and it's slowing reviewers.
Aisha: Yes — please use this lightweight template (copy/paste for manager):
```
Candidate: <Name> / IC
Current Level: <L3>
Proposed Level: <L4>
Summary (2-3 bullets): impact + scale
Examples (3): bullet list, include metrics or links to PRs/docs
Manager recommendation: salary band + comp rationale
Attachments: 2 supporting artifacts (prod metrics, peer feedback, architecture docs)
```
Aisha: Also add `Comp Queue ID:` once you hit submit so payroll can tie it to the request.
Sam: And what about prorating? If the promotion is mid-pay-period are we prorating base and stock portion?
Aisha: Base is prorated from effective date. Stock grants follow standard equity ops timeline (grant window next grant cycle) — we put that in the approval note so comp ops can schedule.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder posted: Payroll cutoff for promo approvals is 2026-04-20 23:59 UTC. Late approvals enter exception flow. :bell:
Diego: For hybrid roles that straddle eng/pm, do we need dual manager evidence or a single manager write-up is fine?
Aisha: Single manager write-up is OK but include cross-functional corroboration (email or brief note) from partner manager. That speeds reviews.
Priya: Appreciate it. One last: if manager needs to escalate because evidence requires confidentiality (legal/merge NDA) — what's the path?
Aisha: Mark the submission `Confidential` and DM me + legal-tag. We'll route to a redacted review queue and arrange an exec-level signoff if needed.
Priya: perfect, sharing the template now. thanks all :heart:
Sam: thanks Aisha! will remind my managers to use the template. :thumbsup:
PeopleOps Bot: Incidentally, here's the short checklist to paste into manager threads: `1) Use template, 2) Attach 2 artifacts, 3) Confirm region, 4) Submit before 2026-04-18`
